role: State Transition Logic Derived from Knot Crossings and Resonance

resonance_embedding.phase_quantization: Phase quantized in units of π/19 (38th roots of unity).

operations.reidemeister_1: Self‑interaction: adds/removes full phase cycle (2π), preserves chirality.
operations.reidemeister_2: Pair interaction: cancels or creates opposite phases.
operations.reidemeister_3: Three‑way interaction: shifts phase by ±2π/3, can flip chirality.

constraint.phase_closure: Sum of phase changes around any closed cycle = 0 mod 2π.
constraint.state_conservation: Sum of states around any closed cycle = 0 mod 3.
